system.api: ADE v2 Parse Jobs (POST /v2/parse/jobs, poll GET /v2/parse/jobs/{job_id})

procedure.runner: Pulse's providers/run.py with our adapter providers/landingai.py (code/landingai.py), registry key landingai_dpt3_pro, concurrency 16
procedure.prediction: every `table` block in the response, in document order, sliced verbatim from the response Markdown by grounding.range; nothing cleaned or edited. A response with no table block has no prediction file and counts as missing
procedure.retries: API errors only (--retry-errors); none occurred. No sample was re-run
procedure.tuning: none; one pass of all samples

command: python -m providers.run run --provider landingai_dpt3_pro && python -m providers.run score --provider landingai_dpt3_pro
